thread:
Alex (Finance): Morning — noticed ~120 customers got small credit memos after the nightly usage/import job. Totals are all tiny (mostly <$5) but it's noisy and affecting AR. Anyone else seeing?

billing-bot: nightly-usage-agg finished: job_id=nj-20240612-03, processed=84,231 accounts, warnings=12, errors=0

Eve (Accounting): Confirming — NetSuite shows ~98 credit memos created between 03:12-03:25 UTC. A handful look duplicated for the same Stripe invoice id. Screenshot posted in #finance (sensitive).

Maria (Engineering): I pulled the usage-agg logs. There's a batch where pricing-experiment delta was applied and then a rollback backfilled the same accounts. Looks like our backfill script emitted negative adjustments that the reconciler treated as new usage records.

Nate (SRE): Also saw a webhook-replay around 03:20 from the ops playbook: `stripe-webhook-replay --since 2024-06-11T02:00Z --events invoice.*` — that replay didn't include an idempotency token for the NetSuite connector, so duplicate credit memos could happen.

Alex (Finance): So two things collided: the pricing rollback produced negative deltas and then replayed webhooks re-created credits in the ledger. Can we stop the connector from replaying until we fix idempotency?

Maria (Engineering): Agreed. Quick debug snippet from the payload we got in the agg job: 
```
{
  "account_id": "acct_abc123",
  "experiment_id": "pricing-experiment-2024-06-10",
  "delta_units": -3,
  "delta_charge_cents": -150
}
```
The reconciler writes a usage line with that as a regular usage row; our idempotency key was `usage_row:{account_id}:{date}` which doesn't include experiment_id, so when rollback ran we wrote a second line with the same key but different sign.

Eve (Accounting): For NetSuite, duplicated credit memos are painful — we have to reverse and reapply. Please pause any replays that touch invoices from 2024-06-10..2024-06-12.

Nate (SRE): I'm toggling the `stripe-replay` feature flag to off for the finance org now. Will also pause the NetSuite outbound queue.

billing-bot: feature-flag updated: stripe-replay=false for org=finance by nate at 1718200245

Maria (Engineering): Plan: 1) hotfix usage-aggregator to include `experiment_id` in idempotency key and ignore negative deltas when `rollback=true` 2) add idempotency header to NetSuite connector when replays run 3) run idempotent reconciliation job to collapse duplicates and mark affected invoices for manual review. I'll open a PR and deploy to staging.

Nate (SRE): For the reconciliation job, run this once patch is live: `recon-cli reconcile --window 2024-06-10..2024-06-12 --idempotent --mark-duplicates` — it'll produce a CSV for accounting to review before NetSuite changes.

Alex (Finance): Please also include a count of impacted customers per tier (free/pro/enterprise) in the CSV. We need to communicate externally if any enterprise customers see billing diffs.

Maria (Engineering): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/482 — contains idempotency change + a guard to skip negative delta writes unless `allow_rollback=true`. Deploy to staging in 15m.

Eve (Accounting): Thanks. Once we have the CSV I'll triage and then ask for NetSuite connector only to resume targeted replays for verified fixes.

Nate (SRE): Staging deploy succeeded at 1718200460. I'll run the recon-cli against staging to sanity check output.

billing-bot: recon-job queued: job_id=recon-1718200500, window=2024-06-10..2024-06-12, requester=maria

Maria (Engineering): Recon job finished on staging — results look sane, duplicates collapsed, no new negative writes. I'm scheduling a prod deploy after a 30m verification.

Alex (Finance): Good. After prod deploy and recon run, let's meet to sign off on NetSuite resume. Also please add a short postmortem entry to the billing-runbook describing experiment_backfill + replay race and the fixes (idempotency + guard).

Eve (Accounting): Will hold on NetSuite changes until I get the CSV and signoff.

Maria (Engineering): Deploying to prod now, will update when done.

Nate (SRE): Prod deploy complete at 1718200575.

Alex (Finance): Thanks all — blocker unblocked for now. Assigning this to Maria to follow up with a brief postmortem and a next-steps checklist.
